blocks.text: WASHINGTON — Hakeem Jeffries is poised to take a major step Wednesday toward becoming the first Black speaker of the US House of Representatives, as victorious Democrats choose their leader after a sweeping midterm election triumph. The 56-year-old New Yorker faces no declared challenger in a closed-door party ballot, putting him on course to preside over a powerful Democratic majority during the final two years of President Donald Trump’s term. But the historic milestone comes with a warning from the party’s energized left flank that, while winning an election is one thing, agreeing on how to wield power is another entirely. […]...
